title: Mavericks 4 | Multicam Capture Made Easy | Evercoast
content:
![Evercoast Mavericks Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/67f6e0fb442cfb2ec547f418_mav.avif)

Multicam capture made easy.

Mavericks 4 enables you to effortlessly capture video from multiple cameras and leverage the power of AI and computer vision to bring it to life.

![a tile of supported cameras](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/68191cedbb1bad6f1714a255_cameras-grid-group-08.avif)

![Mavericks UI for controlling the camera settings](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/67b4d1a33244ff248190fb0a_Control.avif)

![Mavericks capture UI](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/67b3d3def963a43e9f21b8e8_Plugin.avif)

Calibrate Multicam Arrays

Use a guided interface to calibrate your cameras, including precise position and orientation, all in standard formats.

![calibration report in Mavericks](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6819000190e2226a175fe4bf_mavericks-calibrate-03.avif)

![Live 3D preview in Mavericks](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/681900015744658724afd77b_mavericks-real-time-preview-03.png)

Real-Time 3D Previsualization

Visualize your setup in real time with live 3D previews so you always know what you’re capturing and how it fits in space.

Unlimited Preview Renders

Generate 4D renders in seconds using Evercoast's Pro Quality for rapid review and iteration on your local machine.

![previewing a take in Mavericks](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/68190001c20b6d5de5284124_mavericks-render-preview-03.avif)
